summary: Frontend testing for AdminLayout and Venezuelan IVA 16% facturación. All features working correctly. Admin sees dedicated AdminLayout with violet theme at /admin, and Comercio users can configure IVA 16% in Facturación page.

issues: Admin sees AdminLayout with ComercioDashboard content at root /. When navigating to /admin they see the admin panel. This is current design but could be improved by auto-redirecting admin to /admin
Warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - minor accessibility issue

passed_tests: Admin Login with admin@nailcost.pro credentials
Admin sees AdminLayout at / (dark slate theme with ADMIN badge)
Admin sees AdminLayout at /admin
Admin header shows 'NailCost ADMIN' branding with violet theme
Admin header has Dashboard navigation link
Admin panel /admin shows admin-specific tabs: Dashboard, Pendientes, Vencidos, Usuarios, Facturas, Analytics
Admin does NOT see Comercio navigation (Cotizador, Inventario, Facturación links) in header
Admin can view subscription stats (Ingresos/Mes, Por Activar, Por Cobrar, Total Usuarios)
Admin can view subscription status breakdown (Activos, En Trial, Vencidos, Pendientes)
Business user login with test_comercio_iva@test.com
Business user sees ComercioLayout with Facturación in navigation
Facturación page loads with data-testid='facturacion-page'
Facturación page shows stats cards: Facturas del Mes, Cobrado, Pendiente, Total Facturado
Config. Fiscal button present and clickable
Config. Fiscal dialog shows: Nombre de la Empresa, RIF, Dirección Fiscal fields
Config. Fiscal dialog shows 'Aplicar IVA (16%)' checkbox
IVA checkbox saves to localStorage and persists
After enabling IVA, header shows 'IVA 16% Activo'
Nueva Factura dialog shows IVA (16%) line in totals section when IVA enabled
Nueva Factura form includes: Cliente, RIF/CI, Dirección, Servicios/Productos, Método de Pago, Descuento
Invoice totals show: Subtotal, Base Imponible, IVA (16%), TOTAL
Reportes Fiscales tab accessible
Monthly fiscal report generation section shows: month selector, Ver Reporte button, Descargar button
Report section mentions IVA breakdown for fiscal declarations

Add aria-describedby to DialogContent components for accessibility compliance
